tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the live web. Returns up to 10 ranked results (title, URL, snippet; plus date and publisher for news, authors/venue/citations for papers). Use it to find URLs, then read them with web_fetch.

query.description: Search keywords. Supports site: and -site: operators.

purpose.description: One sentence on why you're searching; improves ranking.

recency_minutes.description: Only results from the last N minutes (e.g. 1440 = 1 day, 10080 = 1 week).

include_domains.description: Comma-separated domains to limit results to, e.g. github.com,arxiv.org.

exclude_domains.description: Comma-separated domains to exclude, e.g. pinterest.com,quora.com.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Read web pages as clean markdown, with JavaScript rendered. Up to 10 URLs per call. Each URL returns at most 20000 characters; a truncated page's header gives the offset to continue from. Markdown conversion can alter structured data (e.g. it escapes _ in JSON keys), so fetch JSON or raw files with a plain HTTP client instead.

offset.description: Character position to start from, applied to every URL. Default 0. To continue a truncated page, use the offset from its header note.
